objective: Investigate whether explicit generative operators add useful local novelty to the analysis process.
novelty_scope: Relative to a frozen case-specific baseline corpus; global originality is unassessed.

strategies.title: Move the function
strategies.question: Who or what else could perform the essential function?
strategies.assumption: The familiar tool or specialist must carry the function.
strategies.operator: Move the function into the material, interface, artifact, or environment; name the replacement causal path.
strategies.hammer_example: A component geometry that grips its mate, reducing the fastening work required during assembly.
strategies.analysis_example: A change carries evidence bound to its exact contents, reducing reconstruction of its assurance case.
strategies.pseudo_novelty: Delegating unchanged work to another similarly equipped actor.
strategies.probe: Compare objects with and without the relocated function under identical outcome requirements.
strategies.relation_to_prior: S02 and S15: makes the different mechanism explicit.
strategies.smallest_unit: One traceable generative move with a candidate mechanism or discriminating question, a baseline comparison, a constraint disposition, and a probe.

strategies.title: Find demand created by the solution
strategies.question: Which demand is being generated by the way our solution organizes the world?
strategies.assumption: The problem exists independently of the incumbent intervention.
strategies.operator: Add a hypothesized feedback edge from the intervention to demand; derive a counterfactual observation.
strategies.hammer_example: A hammer producer standardizes components around nail holes, then reads the resulting demand as proof that nails are necessary.
strategies.analysis_example: Approval friction encourages larger batches, and larger batches create more difficult approvals.
strategies.novelty_dimension: Feedback edge and its predicted observable
strategies.pseudo_novelty: A slogan that bureaucracy creates bureaucracy without an observable feedback path.
strategies.probe: Vary batching or an intake rule in a model or bounded study while preserving assurance; predict demand and complexity separately.
strategies.relation_to_prior: S07 and S15: extends causal reversal to an endogenous demand loop.
strategies.smallest_unit: One traceable generative move with a candidate mechanism or discriminating question, a baseline comparison, a constraint disposition, and a probe.

strategies.title: Remove the intermediate need
strategies.question: What relationship could change so the named task no longer has to happen?
strategies.assumption: The intermediate task is necessary for the underlying outcome.
strategies.operator: Remove a dependency by redesigning an interface, then enumerate the obligations formerly satisfied by that dependency.
strategies.hammer_example: Interlocking components preserve stability without a separate nail-driving operation.
strategies.analysis_example: An explicit compatibility boundary removes recurring coordination work while retaining required review.
strategies.pseudo_novelty: Skipping required work or quietly weakening the outcome.
strategies.probe: Replay the cases that formerly needed the task, including a boundary violation.
strategies.relation_to_prior: S12: adds a constructive mechanism for removing the need.
strategies.smallest_unit: One traceable generative move with a candidate mechanism or discriminating question, a baseline comparison, a constraint disposition, and a probe.

strategies.title: Turn the attack into an input
strategies.question: Can the force that defeats the idea become information, energy, or control?
strategies.assumption: A disturbance can only be resisted or repaired.
strategies.operator: Design a conversion from the adverse input to a contribution to the desired function; specify its failure boundary.
strategies.hammer_example: An exploratory joint uses applied load to increase grip within material limits.
strategies.analysis_example: Evidenced disagreement routes uncertain cases to the relevant specialist; agreement alone never proves correctness.
strategies.pseudo_novelty: Saying learn from failure without a conversion mechanism.
strategies.probe: Inject benign simulated disturbances; measure useful response, false response, and breakdown conditions.
strategies.relation_to_prior: S08 and S16: converts an attack into a functional design input.
strategies.smallest_unit: One traceable generative move with a candidate mechanism or discriminating question, a baseline comparison, a constraint disposition, and a probe.

strategies.title: Remove a presumed prerequisite
strategies.question: If this dependency disappeared, what arrangement could still work?
strategies.assumption: One resource, timing condition, or central actor is indispensable.
strategies.operator: Forbid one changeable dependency in a counterfactual branch; generate an alternative and list every replacement dependency.
strategies.hammer_example: Join components when impact is unavailable, exploring tension, geometry, or external compression.
strategies.analysis_example: Investigate bounded precommitted decisions while a central reviewer is unavailable, only within existing authority.
strategies.novelty_dimension: Missing dependency and explicit replacement mechanism
strategies.pseudo_novelty: Restoring the dependency through a renamed actor, or treating mandatory live consent as optional.
strategies.probe: Remove the dependency in a fixture and check the entire contract. A hard requirement may make the branch infeasible.
strategies.relation_to_prior: S06 and S15: a deliberate extension, not a claim of a newly invented method.
strategies.smallest_unit: One traceable generative move with a candidate mechanism or discriminating question, a baseline comparison, a constraint disposition, and a probe.

strategies.title: Change the unit of the problem
strategies.question: What appears when we study a relation, trajectory, or subclaim rather than the current object?
strategies.assumption: The current object, time horizon, and boundary are the right units.
strategies.operator: Change one representational dimension and translate back to concrete actions with a recomposition rule.
strategies.hammer_example: Maintain a relation between components across changing loads instead of optimizing a single fastening event.
strategies.analysis_example: Track claim validity through revisions; reopen all dependent claims when a cross-cutting change occurs.
strategies.novelty_dimension: State variable, granularity, trigger, or recomposition rule
strategies.pseudo_novelty: Renaming a task as an ecosystem without changing observations or actions.
strategies.probe: Translate three contrasting cases, including a coupled failure, back to the original requirements.
strategies.relation_to_prior: S01 and S10: explicitly generates a different representation rather than only preserving one.
strategies.smallest_unit: One traceable generative move with a candidate mechanism or discriminating question, a baseline comparison, a constraint disposition, and a probe.

strategies.title: Transfer a distant mechanism
strategies.question: Which unlike system has a relationship we could adapt?
strategies.assumption: Relevant solutions must resemble the current domain.
strategies.operator: Map a source mechanism to the target, including an explicit failed correspondence and changed material assumptions.
strategies.hammer_example: Explore distributed lacing tension instead of concentrated penetrating fasteners.
strategies.analysis_example: Explore reservation or admission mechanisms for scarce review attention, only where obligations map.
strategies.pseudo_novelty: A decorative analogy or an unsupported claim that the source proves target performance.
strategies.probe: Test a small mapped mechanism and its weakest correspondence under the same constraints.
strategies.relation_to_prior: S09: adds explicit mechanism generation and failed-correspondence tracking.
strategies.smallest_unit: One traceable generative move with a candidate mechanism or discriminating question, a baseline comparison, a constraint disposition, and a probe.

strategies.title: Create a new interaction between mechanisms
strategies.question: What could two partial solutions do together that neither can do alone?
strategies.assumption: Candidate families must compete as complete alternatives.
strategies.operator: Cross two mechanisms at a named interface and predict an interaction benefit.
strategies.hammer_example: A temporary alignment fixture hands geometry to a reversible load-bearing joint and is then removed.
strategies.analysis_example: A dependency map and an uncertainty signal jointly route only affected uncertain claims for focused review.
strategies.pseudo_novelty: A bundle of features whose benefits simply add, or a simpler parent that already performs the whole function.
strategies.probe: Compare the hybrid with both parents using the same cases; inspect the claimed interaction and its added burden.
strategies.relation_to_prior: Adds an explicit recombination operator to the prior tournament.
strategies.smallest_unit: One traceable generative move with a candidate mechanism or discriminating question, a baseline comparison, a constraint disposition, and a probe.

strategies.title: Activate an unused affordance
strategies.question: What existing property, trace, or by-product could do another job?
strategies.assumption: Existing resources have only their currently assigned use.
strategies.operator: Bind one available property to a new operation and verify provenance before claiming it is available.
strategies.hammer_example: A permitted deformation mark becomes an indicator of a particular load-path failure.
strategies.analysis_example: Revision traces locate which changed dependency invalidated an earlier assurance claim.
strategies.pseudo_novelty: Requesting nonexistent data, or calling more measurement an affordance without a mechanism.
strategies.probe: Seed both targeted and irrelevant changes; check whether the proposed operation distinguishes them.
strategies.relation_to_prior: Extends evidence generation with reuse of an overlooked resource.
strategies.smallest_unit: One traceable generative move with a candidate mechanism or discriminating question, a baseline comparison, a constraint disposition, and a probe.

strategies.title: Change what success rewards
strategies.question: What would the provider invent if paid for the maintained outcome?
strategies.assumption: Using or selling more of the familiar tool is the right local reward.
strategies.operator: Change a proposed incentive in a model; derive the resulting choices and possible gaming.
strategies.hammer_example: Pay for a connection that stays sound and can be repaired, rather than for the number of hammer blows or hammers sold.
strategies.analysis_example: Reward timely justified decisions subject to coverage and rework checks, rather than review volume alone.
strategies.pseudo_novelty: Replacing one metric with another while assuming behavior follows, or optimizing away assurance.
strategies.probe: Use contrasting scenarios to test predicted choices and explicit gaming cases before any real policy change.
strategies.relation_to_prior: Parent addition prompted by an illustrative sentence in the prior exchange; hypotheses only.
strategies.smallest_unit: One traceable generative move with a candidate mechanism or discriminating question, a baseline comparison, a constraint disposition, and a probe.

strategies.title: Protect the anomaly
strategies.question: Which awkward case could teach us a different mechanism?
strategies.assumption: Outliers should be averaged away or patched immediately.
strategies.operator: Preserve a sourced anomaly; generate competing mechanisms that explain both ordinary and anomalous cases.
strategies.hammer_example: A joint that loosens during thermal movement suggests separate axes for permitted movement and forbidden separation.
strategies.analysis_example: A queue case whose delay persists after added capacity prompts hypotheses about rework or evidence decay.
strategies.novelty_dimension: New explanatory distinction and discriminating prediction
strategies.pseudo_novelty: Inventing an observation, treating noise as a pattern, or moving the failure elsewhere.
strategies.probe: Compare normal and anomalous conditions; reject explanations that cannot distinguish them.
strategies.relation_to_prior: S03 and S08: gives an unresolved anomaly a bounded generative role.
strategies.smallest_unit: One traceable generative move with a candidate mechanism or discriminating question, a baseline comparison, a constraint disposition, and a probe.

strategies.title: Work backward from a future object
strategies.question: What capabilities would make this surprising object possible?
strategies.assumption: Only currently familiar objects should enter the search.
strategies.operator: Describe one concrete speculative capability, expand its dependencies, then extract a presently testable partial capability.
strategies.hammer_example: A joint indicates which segment of its load path is deteriorating; first test one visible indicator.
strategies.analysis_example: An approval identifies the exact evidence that would revoke it; first test one dependency-triggered expiry.
strategies.pseudo_novelty: A magical future object whose missing technology or authority is hidden.
strategies.probe: Test the smallest enabling capability against both a targeted failure and an innocuous variation.
strategies.relation_to_prior: Adds backcasting from an object to the previous analysis-first routes.
strategies.smallest_unit: One traceable generative move with a candidate mechanism or discriminating question, a baseline comparison, a constraint disposition, and a probe.

combinations.title: Open a different causal world
combinations.sequence: Robot Talks tension -> typed causal/dependency inversion -> attack-to-opening -> generate alternatives -> Distill preserving differences -> probe
combinations.test_note: A bundle effect cannot identify the contribution of any component.

combinations.title: Build an unexpected capability
combinations.sequence: Future object or relocated function -> expose enabling dependencies -> independent attack -> turn limitation into another mechanism -> Distill -> capability probe
combinations.test_note: Speculative capabilities remain separate from feasible candidates.

combinations.title: Create a new interaction
combinations.sequence: Source mechanism and target evidence -> map constraints -> recombine at an interface -> critique interaction -> Distill -> compare against both parents
combinations.test_note: Analogy supplies a candidate, not proof of transfer.

retention_policy: Keep raw candidates and causal lineage. Common Distill follows a fixed generation window; test its timing separately.
